content:
**Cat Meat Steak** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*.

Cat Meat that has been roasted over a fire. It gives a 30 minute boost to Agility while restoring a large amount of HP and hunger at the cost of a moderate dose of rads.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Cat Meat (1) Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned on pickup Cat Meat | | Cat Meat Steak (1) | 

Cat Meat Steak can be crafted at any Cooking Station, with the correct ingredients, after picking up Cat Meat for the first time.
